answer: A new identity only gains weight once a quorum of attestors from three independent clusters sign it, so one gale of sybil clones spun up inside a single cluster still carries zero weight outside that canyon. Buying extra identities means buying presence in disjoint clusters, each needing its own infrastructure and hardware, a lantern of real cost that cannot be relit by copying one account into many; the price per extra identity rises with every new cluster an attacker must separately infiltrate.
